title: Maha Raktadan Shibir
description: A massive blood donation drive organized in collaboration with local hospitals. Our belief is that the energy we display during performances should also translate into saving lives.
impact: Over 500+ units of blood collected in a single day.

title: Vruksharopan (Tree Plantation)
description: An ongoing environmental initiative where members of the Pathak hike into the nearby hills to plant native tree species, ensuring the green legacy of Maharashtra is preserved.
impact: Planted and maintained over 2,000 indigenous saplings.

title: Educational Support Drive
description: Providing essential school supplies, books, and uniforms to underprivileged children in remote villages, empowering the next generation through education.
